lines.t: Thus says the Lord to his servants, you have been faithful and from your mouths
You have testified of my glory, yet I tell you let judgment be no more upon your lips
And cause unforgiveness to pass from your hearts
When a brother or sister has gone astray
And done that which I said they shall not do
I ask you, what is that to you?
Do they not answer to their own master?
Judge not another servant, but to your own master be true
Love speak not one word concerning those who have hurt you
Not one more word against those who have betrayed you
Forgive them, pray for them and let them go their way
Love your enemies and pray for those who betray you
Double for those who fight against you
For they have lifted up their heel against me
Let resentment pass from your heart
And no more let your tongue cause you to stumble on their account
For each is accountable for their own heart
And that which flows from it even to every idle word
Beloved, speak not one word concerning those who ever hurt you
Not one more word against those who have betrayed you
Forgive them, pray for them and let them go their way
Love your enemies and pray for those who betray you

Not one more word against those who have betrayed you
